title: Ice Hockey Advent Calendar – 24 Doors with Hockey Gear
seo_description: A countdown to Christmas that's actually about what they're interested in – not a random chocolate calendar.
descriptionHtml:
The chocolate calendar says nothing about the hockey interest

December is packed with games, but Christmas Eve still feels far away. A hockey fan who gets an ordinary chocolate calendar opens it in ten seconds and tosses it – no connection to what they actually sit and watch every evening.

A calendar that's hockey all the way through

The box is hockey without compromise: an ice rink, floodlights and crossed sticks printed all over the front, with 24 numbered doors counting down to Christmas Eve. Behind the doors waits an assortment of hockey gear and collectible figures in different team colors – no chocolate, nothing that competes with the advent candlestick for attention.

What you get

  • A countdown to Christmas that's actually about what they're interested in – not a random chocolate calendar.
  • 24 days without having to come up with new ways to show that you've thought about their hockey interest.
  • No unnecessary chocolate or candy in the calendar – just a hockey theme.
  • A box that looks nice on the shelf or table all through December.
  • Only one variant to choose from – no hassle with colors or models before you buy.
  • Cardboard box, 22 × 32 × 4 cm, with an ice rink, floodlights and hockey sticks printed on the front
  • 24 numbered, perforated doors – one to open each day until Christmas Eve
  • Assortment of hockey gear and collectible figures: plastic mini hockey sticks, metal/leather-strap keyrings and figures with hockey helmets in different team colors
  • Completely free of alcohol and candy
  • One variant – no choice of color or model

Frequently asked questions

What's behind the doors?
An assortment of hockey gear and collectible figures – for example mini hockey sticks, keyrings and figures with hockey helmets in different team colors. We don't state exactly which item is behind each individual door.

Does the calendar contain candy or alcohol?
No. The calendar is completely free of both candy and alcohol – the contents are hockey accessories and collectible figures, nothing to eat or drink.

What age is the calendar suitable for?
There is no age limit stated on the packaging. The contents are small items and collectible figures, so we recommend that an adult keep an eye on it if there are younger siblings in the house.

Are the figures licensed team products?
The packaging doesn't say, so we don't promise any official team or league license – the calendar is sold as a hockey-themed Christmas calendar, not as branded merchandise.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
